newsitem.title: USA: Barnett Q3 shr $0.65 after SAIF charge.
newsitem.headline: Barnett Q3 shr $0.65 after SAIF charge.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1996 net both periods includes a $0.08 per share charge for Savings Association Insurance Fund special assesment. Third quarter total assets were $40.651 billion compared to $41.136 billion for the year-ago period. Total deposits were $32.673 billion compared to $33.477 billion for the year-ago period, and net loans were $30.547 billion compared to $30.191 billion for the year-ago period.
Third quarter fully diluted shares outstanding were 191.9 million, down 6 percent from the previous year, as part of the company's ongoing capital management program.
Shares adjusted for 2-for-1 stock split in September.
Full bank name is Barnett Banks Inc.
